messages:
maria: Quick heads up — PR #2489 needs a merge but CI is failing on style/lint after the formatter ran.

maria: Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/pr/2489

dev-bot: CI failed on `golangci-lint` in `pkg/serving/runtime.go`:
```
serving/runtime.go:145:6: exported type KVCaChe should have comment or be unexported (golint)
serving/runtime.go:203:2: `ctx` is unused (gosimple)
```

alex: I'll take the lint fixes. Do we prefer renaming to `KVCache` or make it unexported? That comment is legit.

sam: prefer `KVCache` (camelcase). It's referenced in a couple of packages — quick search shows uses in `eng-runtime` and tests.

pranav: I can push a tiny follow-up that fixes the unused ctx too. Planning to squash with the formatting commit.

alex: Cool. Plan:
- I rename `KVCaChe` -> `KVCache` and add a one-line comment.
- Pranav removes the unused `ctx` param and runs `make fmt && make lint`.

maria: FYI, keep the PR small. If you need me to approve after CI passes, ping me.

pranav: Pushed a fix: `git commit -m "fix(lint): KVCache name + remove unused ctx"` — CI kicked.

dev-bot: CI passed — all checks green :white_check_mark:

alex: Merged via squash, merge commit `c3f9a7e`. Thanks all :tada:

maria: Awesome. Can we add a quick changelog note in the PR body next time for reviewer context? small ask.

alex: Yep, will do.

maria: Closing the loop. :thumbsup:
